name: Halla
title: Yardmaster of Dawnmead
examine: Wayward Watch, retired on a bad knee that predicts rain better than any almanac. The dummies flinch when she counts.
lines: Third cut lands hardest. Stay in and finish.
Knee says rain by dusk. The knee has never once been wrong.
The granary rats keep my wakers honest. Better teachers than me, some mornings.
